import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def task_func(rows=5, cols=5):
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    available_categories = [
        "Category A",
        "Category B",
        "Category C",
        "Category D",
        "Category E",
    ]

    if cols > len(available_categories):
        raise ValueError("Number of columns exceeds the number of available categories.")

    selected_categories = available_categories[:cols]
    data = np.random.rand(rows, cols)
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        data,
        columns=selected_categories,
        index=[f"Row {i + 1}" for i in range(rows)],
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    df.plot(kind="bar", stacked=True, ax=ax)

    ax.set_title("Stacked Bar Chart of Random Numerical Data")
    ax.set_xlabel("Rows")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.legend(title="Categories")

    return ax
